mainEntity.name: Can I perform AI-ready website optimization myself, or do I need a specialist?

acceptedAnswer.text: While basic SEO adjustments can often be handled internally, comprehensive AI-ready website optimization typically requires specialized expertise. It involves a deep understanding of structured data markup, natural language processing principles, and the nuances of various AI algorithms. A specialist can conduct thorough audits, implement complex technical changes, and develop a strategic content plan that aligns with AI's understanding. DIY attempts might cover surface-level aspects, but a professional ensures your site is optimally prepared for the evolving AI landscape, maximizing your competitive advantage.
acceptedAnswer.description: While some basic adjustments are possible, comprehensive AI-ready website optimization often requires specialists due to the complexities of structured data, natural language processing, and AI algorithms.
